steps.title: Initialize Git Repository
steps.description: Create a new project folder and turn it into a Git repository.
tasks: Configure git user: `git config user.name 'Student' && git config user.email 'student@opsacademy.com'`

steps.title: Make Your First Commit
steps.description: Create a file, stage it, and record a commit snapshot.

verification.command: cd /home/student/git-demo && git log --oneline | grep -q 'Initial commit' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Create and Merge a Branch
steps.description: Create a feature branch, make a change, and merge it back to main.
tasks: Stage and commit: `git add auth.js && git commit -m 'Add auth'`
Switch back to main: `git checkout main`

verification.command: cd /home/student/git-demo && test -f auth.js && git log --oneline | grep -q 'Add auth' && echo PASS || echo FAIL
